ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: The AI services that sites can chat through. Each site chooses one on its own page, and the keys stay here.
ai.assistant.title: Assistant
ai.assistant.hint: A chat panel, under **Assistant** in the menu, that manages this server for you with the rights of whoever is signed in. It asks before it deletes anything, and every message is billed to the provider's key.
ai.assistant.members: Members may use it too, with only a member's rights
ai.assistant.memberLimit: Messages a member may send per day
ai.assistant.memberLimitHint: Counted per day in UTC; 0 means no limit. Administrators are never limited.
ai.assistant.savedOn: The assistant is on. Open it from Assistant in the menu.
ai.assistant.usage.title: Used today
ai.add.title: Add a provider
ai.add.hint: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again, and every chat is billed to its owner. Leave the base URL empty to use OpenAI or Anthropic directly, or the key empty for a provider that needs none.
ai.field.name: Name
ai.add.done: Added {name}. Test it below, then choose it on a site's page.
ai.providers.title: Providers
ai.providers.empty: There are no providers yet. Add one above, then choose it on a site's page, in its AI section.
ai.providers.testHint: **Test** sends “{prompt}” and shows the answer, the model, the tokens it used and how long it took.
ai.providers.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} and its key? This cannot be undone.
ai.providers.deleteConfirmUsed.one: Delete {name} and its key? The site that uses it will have no AI until it gets another provider. This cannot be undone.
ai.providers.deleteConfirmUsed.other: Delete {name} and its key? The {count} sites that use it will have no AI until they get another provider. This cannot be undone.
ai.providers.deleted: Deleted {name} and its key. Sites that used it have no AI until they get another provider.
ai.test.answered: {name} answered in {ms} ms with {answer}. Model {model}, {inputTokens} tokens in and {outputTokens} out.
ai.test.answeredWithStop: {name} answered in {ms} ms with {answer}. Model {model}, {inputTokens} tokens in and {outputTokens} out, stopping on {stopReason}.
ai.error.kind: Choose a kind: {openai} for OpenAI and anything that copies its API, or {anthropic}.
ai.error.nameRequired: Give the provider a name, such as "OpenAI" or "Claude Sonnet".
ai.error.nameLong: A provider's name can be at most {max} characters.
ai.error.nameLine: A provider's name is one line of text.
ai.error.nameTaken: A provider called {name} already exists. Give this one another name, so sites can tell them apart.
ai.error.baseUrlRequired: A base URL is required, such as `https://api.openai.com/v1` or `https://api.anthropic.com`.
ai.error.baseUrlLong: A base URL can be at most {max} characters.
ai.error.baseUrlForm: The base URL must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` address, such as `https://api.openai.com/v1` or `https://api.anthropic.com`.
ai.error.baseUrlKey: Put the key in the API key box rather than in the base URL.
ai.error.baseUrlQuery: The base URL cannot have a query string or a fragment: the server adds the endpoint's path to it.
ai.error.keyLarge: An API key can be at most {size} KB.
ai.error.keyLine: An API key is one line of text, with no line breaks.
ai.error.modelRequired: Name the default model, such as `gpt-4o-mini` or `claude-sonnet-5`.
ai.error.modelLong: A model name can be at most {max} characters.
ai.error.modelSpaces: A model name has no spaces.
ai.error.providerGone: That provider no longer exists. It may have just been deleted.
ai.models.error.baseUrl: The base URL cannot be used.
ai.models.error.refused: The provider refused the key, so it would not list its models.
ai.models.error.noList: This provider does not list its models. Type the model's name instead.
ai.models.error.status: The provider answered {status} when asked for its models.
ai.models.error.timeout: The provider did not list its models in time.
ai.models.error.unreachable: The provider could not be reached to list its models.
ai.site.error.noProvider: Choose a provider, or remove the AI settings instead.
ai.site.error.unknownProvider: That AI provider does not exist. An administrator can add one under AI.
ai.site.error.promptLarge: The system prompt can be at most {size} KB.
ai.assistant.error.providerGone: That AI provider no longer exists.
ai.assistant.error.modelLong: The model name must be {max} characters or fewer.
ai.assistant.error.dailyLimit: The daily limit for members is 0 (no limit) to {max} messages.
ai.assistant.error.off: The assistant is not turned on for you. An administrator sets it up under AI.
ai.assistant.error.messageLong: A message is limited to 8,000 characters.
ai.assistant.error.ended: That conversation has ended. Start a new one.
ai.assistant.error.busy: The assistant is still working on your last message.
ai.assistant.error.waiting: Choose Run or Cancel for the step that is waiting first.
ai.assistant.error.tooLong: This conversation is long enough to slow every answer down. Start a new one.
ai.assistant.error.server: The assistant ran into a problem on the server. The details are in the server log.
ai.assistant.error.unfinished: The AI provider ended its answer without finishing it. Try again.
ai.assistant.error.cutOff: The answer was cut off at its length limit.
ai.assistant.error.steps: Stopped after {count} steps. Say what to do next, more precisely.
ai.assistant.limit.message: {sent} {resets} An administrator can raise the limit under AI.
ai.assistant.limit.sent.one: You have sent today's {count} message to the assistant, the most a member may.
ai.assistant.limit.sent.other: You have sent today's {count} messages to the assistant, the most a member may.
ai.assistant.limit.resets.one: It starts again at midnight UTC, in about {count} hour.
ai.assistant.limit.resets.other: It starts again at midnight UTC, in about {count} hours.
